18 themes x an identical token block. The symmetry is enforced, not incidental: check-contrast asserts a symmetric token set across all 18 (558 WCAG pairs) and check-usage asserts every reference resolves. Splitting per-theme would scatter the thing those gates read as one unit.

TOOLS is a declarative registry of 19 MCP tool definitions and is 74% of the file by design — CLAUDE.md and docs/MCP.md both document 'add a tool = add to TOOLS in tools.ts'. Splitting the array is exactly the relocation the finding itself warns against, and it would break the one-place-to-look contract the docs promise.

A flat list of 57 zod schemas with no shared logic — the largest symbol is 28 lines. The size is the count of endpoints the worker validates, so any split produces schemas-agent-a/b with an arbitrary line between them and one more import hop per schema.
